candidate_workaround: Remove only the reported owner-local whitespace defect, restage, and rerun the unchanged diff check.
failure_signature: Git staged diff hygiene reports a new blank line at end of file.
recurrence_guard: Run staged diff hygiene before every commit and correct only attributable owner-local defects.
rollback: Retain the failed staged check, avoid committing, and leave all sibling and inherited paths unchanged.
scope_boundary: Owner-local staged whitespace recovery only; no x2, canonical-final, or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Gate every commit on exact staged diff hygiene
trigger_preconditions: An additive owner-local staged file fails Git diff hygiene.
